primary.title: The Epistles of Paul
primary.author: Paul the Apostle
primary.rationale: Collection of letters attributed to Paul, forming a significant portion of the New Testament and foundational to early Christian theology.

primary.title: Epistle to the Romans
primary.author: Paul the Apostle
primary.rationale: One of the most influential of Paul's letters, offering a systematic exposition of his theology.

primary.title: First Epistle to the Corinthians
primary.author: Paul the Apostle
primary.rationale: Addresses various issues within the Corinthian church, providing insights into early Christian community life and Paul's pastoral concerns.

secondary.title: Paul: A Very Short Introduction
secondary.author: E. P. Sanders
secondary.rationale: A concise and accessible overview of Paul's life, letters, and theology by a leading scholar in the field.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to St. Paul
secondary.author: James D. G. Dunn
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive collection of essays by various scholars covering different aspects of Paul's life, thought, and influence.

secondary.title: Paul and the Law
secondary.author: Heikki Räisänen
secondary.rationale: A significant scholarly work that critically examines Paul's complex relationship with Jewish law.

suggestions.notes: The primary sources are the letters attributed to Paul in the New Testament. The years provided are approximate dates of composition. Secondary sources are chosen for their scholarly reputation and accessibility.
